 ALL GOALS: Real Madrid vs Leipzig | UEFA Champions League
 Real Madrid look to keep their winning run alive against an RB Leipzig side coming off a brutal domestic defeat but showing better form in Europe.
 Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig: Date, Time and Venue
 Real Madrid host RB Leipzig this Wednesday, October 21 at 3:00 PM ET at the Santiago Bernabéu on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League league phase.
 Romanian referee István Kovács will take charge of a matchup in which Los Blancos will look to extend a winning streak that is beginning to change the mood around the team.
 Leipzig arrive in a very different position. Their heavy Bundesliga defeat raised serious concerns, although their Champions League form suggests they are capable of offering much stronger resistance at the Bernabéu.
